summary: Carter County, TN tower at 2,251 ft; Tennessee Landforms calls it historical, Forest Lookouts says removed, and no source gives a date or describes the site.

facts.status_note: Removed according to Forest Lookouts; Tennessee Landforms calls it historical. No source gives a removal date or describes what remains at the site today.

notes_for_editor: Two web sources only. Landforms gives county, elevation and historical status; the Forest Lookouts page gives county and Removed, with no date. The National Register form lists Stony Creek (Carter) in its table with no details. Not the same as the Holston Mountain tower in Carter County, which is a different structure and is not used here. Access and site condition are unknown; the record already carries the Forest Lookouts photo, so no new photos were added.
